definitions.gloss: 77th birthday; celebration of one's seventy-seventh year
definitions.explanation: A celebration of a person's 77th birthday. The term comes from the cursive form of the character {喜|よろこ}び (joy), whose shape resembles the figures for seventy-seven.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喜寿|きじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{喜寿|きじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: We held a celebration for his seventy-seventh birthday.

examples.japanese: {喜寿|きじゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{七十七|しちじゅうしち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The term kiju comes from the fact that the cursive form of the character for "joy" looks like seventy-seven.

notes:
A celebration of one's 77th birthday, one of the traditional longevity milestones. The name plays on the cursive form of ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧, which resembles the figures for seventy-seven.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喜寿|きじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's seventy-seventh year
- {喜寿|きじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: a 77th-birthday celebration
